title: Annuities and interest rates
idea: Most real cash flows are streams, not single sums, and quoted rates hide compounding.

sections.b: An annuity pays equal amounts for a fixed term. PV = C × [1 − (1 + r)−n] / r. $100 a year for 10 years at 8% is worth $671.01.
The EAR includes compounding: EAR = (1 + APR/m)m − 1. A 12% APR compounded monthly is an EAR of 12.68%.

traps: A perpetuity's PV is C / r: no n, because it never ends.
